digest.component_or_area: store push and initialization with S3 remotes
propositions: An s3:// or s3+zip:// ticket remote without the git-remote-s3 helper (or with version <0.3.2) must fail closed at init and push time with an actionable error message, not silently corrupt the store.

The preflight check _require_s3_helper_if_s3_url() detects S3 mode by URL scheme and unconditionally raises OptionalDependencyError independent of strict mode, so it propagates through write_and_push and overrides best-effort error handling.

The preflight is called after URL resolution in push.py (line ~418), in the async arm before detaching, and in init.py _mount_or_create_branch, reusing existing git remote get-url calls with no new resolution seam.
Non-s3:// remotes and unresolvable remotes are no-ops; the preflight introduces no config schema changes and detects mode purely from remote URL scheme.
